key_insight: DOPD improves on-policy distillation by dynamically routing token-level supervision between privileged teacher and privileged student signals to avoid “privilege illusion” and better transfer real capability.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a more stable and effective distillation recipe for compressing LLMs and VLMs while preserving performance under robustness, continual learning, and distribution shift.
method: Advantage-aware dual distillation selects supervision from either privileged teacher or privileged student per token.
Routing depends on advantage gap and relative token probabilities to balance strength, objective, and strategy.
Targets only the small subset of capability-bearing tokens with differentiated supervision to reduce information-asymmetry artifacts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on both LLM and VLM settings, with DOPD consistently outperforming Vanilla OPD and additional evaluations showing better stability, robustness, continual learning, and out-of-distribution performance.
watch_item: Implementation may be sensitive to correctly estimating token-level advantages and routing supervision only where signals are truly capability-bearing, since misrouting could reintroduce privilege illusion.
